children.text: The free energy change for a process may be viewed as a measure of its driving force. A negative value for Δ
represents a driving force for the process in the forward direction, while a positive value represents a driving force for the process in the reverse direction. When Δ
is zero, the forward and reverse driving forces are equal, so the process occurs in both directions at the same rate (the system is at equilibrium).
